full_judgment:
3. The learned Additional Sessions Judge by the judgment dated April 27, 1996 found the accused-appellant Nurul Islam guilty under Section 302 of the Penal Code and found accused Khalil and Nawab Ali guilty under section 302/34 of the penal Code and convicted them thereunder and sentenced each of them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for life and also a fine of Tk. 10,000/= each, in default, to suffer rigorous imprisonment for two years more. 

 4. The accused Khalil and Nawab Ali were tried in absentia. The accused-appellant Nurul Islam alone presented this appeal before this Court against the said judgment and order of conviction and sentence. 

 The First Information Report was lodged by P.W.5 Madhu Mia, full-brother of deceased Ali Ahmed. On the night following 29.10.92 at about 2.00 A.M. some miscreants broke open the door of the but of deceased Ali Ahmed and switched on the electric light and started Searching Ali Ahmed. The miscreants shouted saying that they would finish Ali Ahmed. With the said utterings they came out of the house. Two miscreants with daggers in their hand stood near the door of the hut. One of the miscreants standing near the door asked Ali Ahmed whether he was Ali Ahmed or not. Another miscreant identified Ali Ahmed. One accused standing by the western side of the window of the but with arms shot at Ali Ahmed who fell down on the floor of the hut. Ali Ahmed, there-after, succumbed to the injuries caused by gun-shot. The miscreant, thereafter, entered into the house and looted money, ornaments, etc. At the shouting of his brother's wife (Bhabi) Informant Ratan Mia, Abdul Majid, Ebadul Member, Rajab Ali and other villagers came to the place of occurrence and heard of the occurrence from his Bhabi who disclosed that she identified accused Nurul Islam, Khalil and Nawab Ali. 

 17. P.W.5 as the Informant gave testimony that he lodged the First Information Report that the dacoits entered into the but of Ali Ahmed by breaking open the door and one dacoit was asking who was Ali Ahmed. One dacoit identified Ali Ahmed and the dacoits thereafter, went out of the but and shot at Ali Ahmed from the window of the western side. This witness further stated that Nurul Islam fired the shot and accused Khalil and Nawab Ali were with him with Knives. It is the further testimony that after firing the dacoits entered into the house and looted away money and other articles ornaments etc. This witness further stated that his Bhabi (P.W.4) identified the dacoits. This witness further stated that with respect to commission of theft of Motor weaving accused Nurul Islam was awarded fine through a village trial (গ্রাম্য বিচার) and for that reason he killed his brother. In cross examination this witness testified that there are 7 to 8 houses in between their house and accused’s house and many people resided in those houses and no person of those houses was cited as witness in the case. 

 18. P.W. 4 Cheharunnessa, the wife of the deceased testified that the dacoits broke open the door and three persons entered into the house and switched the electric light. One of the dacoits wanted to know who was Ali Ahmed and one dacoit identified his husband as Ali Ahmed She further stated that accused Nurul Islam, Nawab Ali and Khalil entered into the house and all three came out of the house and Nurul Islam from the window the western side fired upon her husband. She further stated that accused Nawab Ali and Khalil stood inform of the kitchen. In the cross-examination she denied the suggestion put forward by the defence that her husband was killed by unknown persons. 

 21. On a close analysis of the testimonies of P.Ws. 4, 5, and 6 it appears that their testimonies suffer from glaring contradictions and discrepancies. P.W. 4 stated that three persons entered into the house and all the three persons went out of the house and Nurul Islam shot at her husband. She also testified that accused Nawab Ali and Khalil stood infront of the Kitchen. P.W. 6 the daughter of the deceased testified that 4/5 persons breaking open the door entered into the but and switched on the electric light. It is the testimony that three persons went out of the house and stood near the window. Further testimony in that one of the accused gave a kick on her and one person standing outside the but fired on her father. This witness also stated that addressing the accused-appellant her mother uttered what he (the accused-appellant) did. This witness also stated that she put question to her mother as to who was Nurul Islam. This witness in the cross-examination stated that she used to know Nurul Islam before hand as he was their neighbour. P.W.4 did not state at all in her evidence what P.W.6 stated. The evidence of P.Ws.; 4 and 6 thus appear to have suffered from glaring contra-dictions and serious discrepancies.
